scope: Concrete deploy_preflight.py review with current round2 code/spec dependencies; approval is for guarded preparation, both CPU restores and raw preflight launch only.

checks.name: review_gates_and_snapshot_identity
checks.evidence: deploy_preflight.py:13-21 requires round2 PASS, no blockers and real-preflight readiness, checks all round2 referenced byte snapshots, then requires this deployment review PASS and verifies its actual reviewed files. The new deployment script itself and the selected parent-spec byte snapshot are included in this review. All 24 round2 snapshot references currently match.

checks.name: guards_before_mutations
checks.evidence: The embedded remote check at :43-57 requires actual prior P3 status complete, absent new root/source, no nvidia-smi compute PIDs, and sufficient free disk before its first mkdir at :54. All uploads, source preparation, phase-directory/spec writes and CPU/model commands occur after this check returns. The local launch marker is checked absent before connecting; it is written only after launch verification.

checks.name: isolated_paths
checks.evidence: The new run root is /root/autodl-tmp/pvground_tail_support_20261002 and the new model source is /root/autodl-tmp/pvground_tail_support_source_20261002_v1/PV-Ground. Preparation copies the September17 original G/D model source, not a P2 source, into that new path. No mutation path points at the current /root/autodl-tmp/pvground_p3_20261002 run or its code.

checks.name: common_original_G
checks.evidence: All four specs retain parent_spec base_terminal=/root/autodl-tmp/mcln_pvground_scanrefer_finetune_20260918_semantic_assignment_v1/terminal.pth and SHA256 0575dfae333dabdf288a470fc09d8967f9867d1853a5f61d9cfc3cbcf7964522, the configured original G. Both arm specs are sent through the reviewed runner CPU mode, which hashes and strictly restores the author state plus complete1072-entry G delta before installing the common tail; deployment requires successful exit and the CPU-restore marker for both before launch. Actual remote weight bytes and CPU success remain pending.

checks.name: module_copies_and_hash_interfaces
checks.evidence: The reviewed runner/controller/source preparation and all seven pvground_* helper files are uploaded at the common root; every root upload is read back byte-for-byte. The same helper bytes are copied to all four phase roots, satisfying the runner output-local hash checks while the root is also the script/PYTHONPATH location. Current source/query, observation, task-query and semantic-assignment helper hashes exactly match the retained parent-spec fields. Each spec receives current candidate/tail/preflight-helper hashes and the newly generated source-port path/hash.

checks.name: parent_interfaces_preserved
checks.evidence: runtime, author checkpoint identity, parent_source_port, training_interface_receipt, input_manifest, reference_fixtures, G helper identities and native supervision settings are retained. model_source/source_port/root are replaced with the isolated new paths; p2 is explicitly changed from the parent value True to False and p3 to True. The preparation script emits the current schema already accepted in round2.

checks.name: paired_protocol_and_references
checks.evidence: In-memory evaluation of the exact spec-update expressions yields only root, support_arm, fused_support and reused_control_root differences between the two arms. Same-arm preflight/full specs differ only in root. Both retain seed2027, batch8, one29778-row fit pass/3723 updates, LR/backbone LR1e-5 and the reviewed native wd5e-4/clip.1 checks. They use the same14-channel head and native tail order. tail_raw references old G control only for initial/order checks; tail_fused explicitly references the new root/tail_raw. The controller additionally requires new tail_raw formal completion before any later fused training.

checks.name: preflight_only_launch
checks.evidence: After both CPU restores, the only screen launch is controller --arm tail_raw --preflight-only. The reviewed controller consequently runs one preflight child and no train/formal phases. The two disposable optimizer updates belong to that planned preflight, not the3723-update experiment. Fused GPU preflight and both full-training phases are not launched. The code has no deletion, kill, installation or package-download action.

checks.name: credential_and_shell_boundary
checks.evidence: The helper reads its SSH password from an environment variable without embedding or printing its value, loads system host keys and does not install an automatic unknown-host acceptance policy. Shell paths/arguments and environment values are quoted with shlex; child runner invocations remain argument lists under the reviewed controller GPU lock. No credential wrapper or environment values were read by this review, and no trust-boundary defect was encountered in the cooperating-operator workflow.

checks.name: executed_local_checks
checks.evidence: Local standard-library AST/compile checks pass for the deployment script, embedded remote-check Python, and four inherited G helpers. The four specs were assembled in memory from their exact AST expressions and selected parent settings; only the not-yet-generated source_port hash was marked pending. Embedded root/source/parent paths match the deployer, and all four remote assertions statically precede the first mkdir. No deployment code, Paramiko import, SSH call, GPU operation or implementation mutation was executed.

nonblocking_findings.title: Inherited G replacement reconstruction witness remains unexecuted
nonblocking_findings.evidence: The reviewed runner still places verify_native_replacement under if not update while both step calls pass True. Deployment does not change that path or claim a fresh G reconstruction/gradient witness.
nonblocking_findings.action: Keep the existing evidence limitation in subsequent reporting; no unrelated G rewrite is requested.
